tests.data:
import random
random.seed(1303)

def _hoare(array, low, high):
    pivot = array[high]
    a, b = low, high - 1
    while True:
        while array[a] < pivot:              # stops on a value >= pivot (the pivot itself stops it)
            a += 1
        while b > a and array[b] > pivot:    # stops on a value <= pivot, or on reaching a
            b -= 1
        if a >= b:                           # the pointers have met
            break
        array[a], array[b] = array[b], array[a]
        a += 1
    array[a], array[high] = array[high], array[a]   # pivot into its final place
    return a

cases = []
for _ in range(500):
    n = random.randint(1, 10)
    arr = [random.randint(-3, 3) for _ in range(n)]
    low = random.randint(0, n - 1)
    cases.append((arr, low, random.randint(low, n - 1)))
want = []
for arr, low, high in cases:
    x = arr[:]
    want.append((_hoare(x, low, high), x))
tests.setup:
got = []
for arr, low, high in cases:
    x = arr[:]
    got.append((partition(x, low, high), x))
tests.expr: next(({'array': cases[i][0], 'low': cases[i][1], 'high': cases[i][2], 'you returned': got[i], 'expected': want[i]} for i in range(len(cases)) if got[i] != want[i]), None)
